question: Using a recursive monthly inventory adjustment model starting from December 2018 inventory levels, where we restock a product if its ending inventory drops below the minimum required level, determine for each product the month in 2019 where the absolute difference between its ending inventory and the minimum required level is the smallest, and return the product_id, that month, and the absolute difference.
sql:
-- Calculate Dec 2018 ending inventory for products with minimums
WITH dec_inv AS (
    SELECT cp.product_id, 
           cp.cumulative_purchases - cs.cumulative_sales as ending_inv
    FROM (
        SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as cumulative_purchases
        FROM purchases
        WHERE purchased <= '2018-12-31'
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) cp
    JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as cumulative_sales
        FROM monthly_sales
        WHERE mth <= '2018-12-01'
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) cs ON cp.product_id = cs.product_id
    WHERE cp.product_id IN (6520, 6600)
)
SELECT * FROM dec_inv ORDER BY product_id

-- Build the recursive monthly inventory simulation
WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
    SELECT '2019-01-01'::VARCHAR AS mth, 1 AS month_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT (DATE(mth) + INTERVAL '1 month')::VARCHAR, month_num + 1
    FROM months
    WHERE month_num < 12
),
dec2018_inventory AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, 
           SUM(p.qty) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ms.qty) FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = p.product_id AND ms.mth <= '2018-12-01'), 0) as ending_inv
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM purchases) p
    WHERE p.product_id IN (6520, 6600)
),
product_mins AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty_minimum, qty_purchase FROM product_minimums
),
-- For each product, simulate month by month
sim AS (
    SELECT 
        d.product_id,
        d.ending_inv as start_inv,
        m.mth,
        m.month_num,
        mb.qty as budget_qty,
        pm.qty_minimum,
        pm.qty_purchase,
        -- After sales
        d.ending_inv - mb.qty as after_sales,
        -- After restock check
        CASE WHEN d.ending_inv - mb.qty < pm.qty_minimum 
             THEN d.ending_inv - mb.qty + pm.qty_purchase
             ELSE d.ending_inv - mb.qty
        END as ending_inv,
        ABS(CASE WHEN d.ending_inv - mb.qty < pm.qty_minimum 
             THEN d.ending_inv - mb.qty + pm.qty_purchase
             ELSE d.ending_inv - mb.qty
        END - pm.qty_minimum) as abs_diff
    FROM dec2018_inventory d
    JOIN months m ON TRUE
    JOIN product_mins pm ON d.product_id = pm.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget mb ON d.product_id = mb.product_id AND m.mth = mb.mth
    WHERE m.month_num = 1
